caption: The drawing depicts a segmented wooden object in the shape of an elongated animal, likely a dog, against a plain beige background. The object consists of three distinct parts: a head and neck section on the left, a central body section in the middle, and a tail and hindquarters section on the right. Each segment is colored in dark brown tones with visible wood grain texture, suggesting a carved wooden material. The head section features a lighter brown band around the neck area and a darker patch at the ear, as well as a simple eye drawn on the side. The body and tail sections are similarly rendered, all appearing to align in a straight horizontal arrangement. The artist’s name, "Mina Lowry," is written in small text at the bottom left corner of the image. The background is lightly marked with subtle stains and signs of aging, and faint pencil writing appears in the upper right corner.
title: Pennsylvania German Toy Dachshund
